title: Spatial orthogonality formula for exact-order Hayes traces
statement: Let E_j=(1+x GF(2)[x])/(x^(j+1)), let P_(j,s) be the degree-n Mangoldt mass on 2^s E_j, and let h_(j,s)=2^(j-floor(j/2^s)). The sum T_(j,s)(n) over characters of exact conductor j and exact order 2^s equals h_(j,s)P_(j,s)-h_(j,s-1)P_(j,s-1)-h_(j-1,s)P_(j-1,s)+h_(j-1,s-1)P_(j-1,s-1).

evidence.supports: The four-term population identity, exact character counts, each order-layer trace, and their conductor total.
evidence.notes: The universal proof is finite-group orthogonality plus two inclusion-exclusions. Both endpoint parities through level 12 are independent mutation controls, not quantifier evidence.

provenance.source: power-subgroup annihilators in the binary principal-unit character group

notes: This identity exposes the exact sparse coefficient imbalance behind each Galois order layer. It supplies no bound on that imbalance by itself.
